meta.title: NLME explorer demo data (simulated)
meta.data_note: Synthetic: 30 virtual subjects simulated with a fixed seed. No patient data.
meta.model: one-compartment, first-order absorption, single oral dose; f(t)=D ka/(V(ka-ke))(exp(-ke t)-exp(-ka t)), ke=CL/V; apparent CL/F, V/F
meta.error_model: proportional: y = f (1 + sigma*eps); no additive floor was needed (all concentrations are well above zero)
meta.estimator: FOCE-I implemented in numpy; inner problem = MAP eta per subject, solved from eta=0 and from the previous eta_hat (lowest converged objective kept, because a flip-flop local minimum exists) (Newton step with the exact Hessian - first derivatives analytic, their central difference gives the second - Fisher-scoring fallback if it is not positive definite, step-halving line search, |grad|<1e-7); Laplace OFV with Gauss-Newton Hessian (d var/d eta and second derivatives of f neglected); outer = scipy BFGS on ln(theta), ln(omega), ln(sigma) with central-difference gradient, gtol 1e-3, maxiter 400
meta.ofv: OFV = sum_i [ m_i ln 2pi + sum_j (ln var_ij + res_ij^2/var_ij) + eta_i' Omega^-1 eta_i + ln|I + Omega J_i' R_i^-1 J_i| ] (constants included, so it is an approximation of -2 ln L)

sampling_note.moderate: 5 samples at 0.5, 1.5, 4, 8, 24 h for every subject
sampling_note.sparse: 3 samples per subject, staggered: one early (0.25-1.5 h), one mid (2-6 h), one late (8-24 h)
sampling_note.same_draws: all scenarios use the same subjects, the same true etas and the same noise draws; the smaller designs are subsets of the rich one

meta.surface_note: OFV slice over ln CL/F x ln V/F (31 x 31, +-0.6), other parameters fixed at their final values, eta_hat re-optimised at each grid point; values rounded to 2 decimals
meta.iteration_note: frames are accepted outer BFGS iterations; iteration 0 = starting values

surface.axes: z[i][j]: i = ln V/F index, j = ln CL/F index; offsets from the final estimate
surface.held_fixed: ka, omega, sigma at their final values; eta_hat re-optimised at every grid point

surface.axes: z[i][j]: i = ln V/F index, j = ln CL/F index; offsets from the final estimate

jacobian_vs_finite_difference.note: analytic J = f * d ln f / d eta vs central differences of f; every 10th set has ka within 1e-9..1e-2 (relative) of ke

replicate_study.order: CL/F, V/F, ka, w_CL, w_V, w_ka, sigma

nlmixr2.statement: R / nlmixr2 / rxode2 were not installed in the environment that generated this file, so the nlmixr2 FOCEi comparison was NOT run.
nlmixr2.how_to_run: python3 tools/nlme_demo.py --csv rich.csv  (columns ID, TIME, DV, AMT, EVID; 100 mg oral dose at time 0) and fit the same model with nlmixr2 est='focei'

crosscheck.fallback: independent brute-force 3-D quadrature of the individual marginal likelihood (validation.laplace_vs_bruteforce) and a scipy L-BFGS-B check of every fifth subject's eta_hat (validation.inner_problem_vs_scipy_lbfgsb)
crosscheck.independent_starts: validation.independent_starts (4 random starting-value sets per scenario, same FOCE-I code, different start)
